convert_swin_checkpoint_to_mmdet: convert a Swin Transformer checkpoint to mmdet format using the CLI with src and dst paths
run_swin_converter_function: run the swin_converter function to transform checkpoint keys from Swin v1 to mmdet naming conventions
rename_backbone_layer_keys: rename backbone layer keys by replacing layers with stages and updating attention and MLP key names
reorder_reduction_norm_tensors: reorder reduction and normalization tensor values to correct the unfold order mismatch between frameworks
save_checkpoint_with_sha_hash: save the converted checkpoint and rename it with a SHA256 hash prefix for version tracking
